steps.title: Review Basel-Stadt registry instructions
steps.description: Consult the current personnel-change guidance and confirm the requirements applicable to the company's legal form.

steps.title: Prepare the Handelsregisteranmeldung
steps.description: Prepare the German-language application identifying the company, the persons concerned and the requested register changes.

steps.title: Verify application signatories
steps.description: Check who is legally entitled to sign the commercial register application for the selected legal form and transaction.

steps.title: Review supporting documents
steps.description: Check the relevant corporate decision, acceptance or departure evidence and required identification documents.

steps.title: Select a permitted submission method
steps.description: Determine whether to submit original paper documents by post or at the counter, or to use a qualified electronic filing procedure.

steps.title: Review the AG application form
steps.description: Use the official AG personnel-change form as the starting point and verify the supporting documents.

steps.title: Check board decision-making
steps.description: Distinguish election by the general meeting from the board's organisational and signing-authority decisions.

warnings: Review the articles of association when determining the competent body for board organisation.
Board membership and signing authority are distinct matters.

steps.title: Review the GmbH application form
steps.description: Use the official GmbH personnel-change form and confirm the applicable management and representation arrangements.

steps.title: Check GmbH management arrangements
steps.description: Review the relevant members' decision, articles of association and management structure.

warnings: Do not automatically apply AG board-election procedures to GmbH management changes.

steps.title: Review appointment decision
steps.description: Check the minutes or valid decision of the corporate body competent to appoint the person.

steps.title: Verify acceptance of appointment
steps.description: Check the accepted evidence of Wahlannahme, such as a signed acceptance declaration, co-signature or recorded acceptance at the meeting.

steps.title: Check identification documents
steps.description: Review the identity-document requirement for a newly registered individual, including any applicable exception where certified signature records already contain the required particulars.

steps.title: Check certified specimen signature
steps.description: Where the appointee is authorised to represent the company, verify the requirements for depositing an officially certified specimen signature.

warnings: Several methods of documenting acceptance of office may be permissible.
A person newly appointed to a corporate body does not necessarily have individual signing authority.

steps.title: Determine the reason for departure
steps.description: Identify whether the person was removed, resigned or left office for another reason.

steps.title: Review departure evidence
steps.description: Check the relevant corporate minutes, resignation letter, co-signed application or other permitted evidence for the circumstances.

steps.title: Check remaining corporate representation
steps.description: Review whether the remaining officers and signatories satisfy applicable representation requirements.

warnings: The supporting documents differ depending on the legal reason for departure.
The departing person may be entitled to request their own deletion if they can provide the required evidence.

steps.title: Review signing-authority decision
steps.description: Check the relevant decision concerning the granting, modification or cancellation of registered signing authority.

steps.title: Confirm the registered signing mode
steps.description: Identify the proposed individual or collective signature arrangement and distinguish signing rights from corporate office.

steps.title: Check documents for newly authorised signatories
steps.description: Determine whether an identity document and certified specimen signature must be submitted.

steps.title: Review cancellation of existing authority
steps.description: If a person is losing signing authority, check whether additional departure or cancellation evidence is required.

warnings: The cancellation procedure may differ for an officer and a signatory without corporate office.
Check the underlying contractual relationship where its termination is relevant to the supporting evidence.

electronicRequirements: Check whether the selected digital submission channel is accepted by the registry.
Use qualified electronic signatures and qualified electronic time stamps meeting Swiss requirements.
Verify the electronic certification requirements for supporting documents.

warnings: This is a preliminary workflow dataset, not a definitive filing checklist.
Verify current Basel-Stadt instructions before submitting any application.
Requirements differ by legal form, registered role and type of change.
Avoid including unnecessary personal or confidential information in publicly accessible registry documents.
Foreign signature certifications may require an apostille or additional legalisation depending on applicable treaties.
Human legal review is required before filing.
